blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Around 300 protesters were detained by police following a protest march in Muntinlupa City on Sunday, according to progressive groups. Lucky Oralleo, spokesperson of Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) – Timog Katagalugan, said police dispersed the protesters as they were preparing to march to Liwasang Bonifacio in Manila to join a larger rally
